LanguageData.MMD_Thought_DependencyMood.label: dependent relationship
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_DependencyMood.description: Emotional stability depends on the presence of a trusted person.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_DependencyMood.stages.0.desc: As long as they are nearby, I can feel safe.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_DependencyMood.stages.1.desc: Without them, I do not know what to do.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_DependencySocial.label: I cannot live without them
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BodyCheckingUrge.label: cannot stop examining bodily flaws
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BodyCheckingUrge.description: I have not checked my appearance recently. Something must be wrong.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BodyCheckingUrge.stages.0.de: I cannot stop checking the bodily flaw I imagine others can see.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_CompulsionUrge.label: compulsion left unsatisfied
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_CompulsionUrge.description: I have not checked everything carefully enough.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_CompulsionUrge.stages.0.desc: Leaving the check unfinished keeps me constantly uneasy.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_HealthCheckUrge.label: afraid of serious illness
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_HealthCheckUrge.description: I have not been examined recently. I may be seriously ill.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_HealthCheckUrge.stages.0.des: Something must be seriously wrong with my body. I need an examination.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BulimiaCycle.label: binge cycle
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BulimiaCycle.stages.0.label: satisfied after bingeing
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BulimiaCycle.stages.0.descri: For a short while, I feel energized and satisfied.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BulimiaCycle.stages.1.label: ashamed after bingeing
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_AgoraphobiaExposure.label: surroundings
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_AgoraphobiaExposure.stages.0: There are clear exits and shelter here. I can control the situation.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_AgoraphobiaExposure.stages.1: This place makes me uneasy, but at least there is cover nearby.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_AgoraphobiaExposure.stages.2: There is nowhere to escape. I could lose control at any moment.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_PanicAftermath.label: afraid of another attack
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_PanicAftermath.stages.0.desc: The loss of control still frightens me. It could happen again at any moment.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_ExplosiveRemorse.label: remorse after rage
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_ExplosiveRemorse.stages.0.de: I should not have lost control. I do not know who I might hurt next.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_NarcissisticState.label: self-image
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_NarcissisticState.stages.1.d: How dare they treat me with such contempt.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SocialCrowd.label: social environment
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SocialCrowd.stages.0.label: quiet solitude
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SocialCrowd.stages.0.descrip: No one is watching me here. I can finally relax.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SocialCrowd.stages.1.label: people nearby
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SocialCrowd.stages.1.descrip: People are nearby, and I cannot stop noticing their attention.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SocialCrowd.stages.2.label: surrounded by a crowd
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SocialCrowd.stages.2.descrip: Everyone is looking at me. I need to leave immediately.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_GeneralizedWorry.label: persistent worry
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_GeneralizedWorry.stages.0.de: At least for now, everything seems calm.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_GeneralizedWorry.stages.1.de: Too many things could go wrong. I cannot stop worrying.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_GeneralizedWorry.stages.2.de: Danger is everywhere. The whole situation could collapse at any moment.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SpecificFear.label: phobic trigger
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SpecificFear.stages.0.label: nothing unwanted in sight
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SpecificFear.stages.0.descri: None of my traumatic triggers are nearby.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SpecificFear.stages.1.label: trauma briefly recalled
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SpecificFear.stages.1.descri: That thing brought back an experience I do not want to remember.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SpecificFear.stages.2.label: lingering trauma
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SpecificFear.stages.2.descri: The traumatic memory keeps returning and will not leave my mind.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SpecificFear.stages.3.label: overwhelmed by trauma
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SpecificFear.stages.3.descri: It feels as though I am inside that experience again. I cannot think clearly.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_Claustrophobia.label: enclosure
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_Claustrophobia.stages.0.desc: There is enough space here. I can leave whenever I need to.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_Claustrophobia.stages.1.desc: The walls and roof are pressing in on me.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_Claustrophobia.stages.2.desc: This room is trapping me. I have to get out.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_AdjustmentStress.label: adjustment stress
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_AdjustmentStress.stages.0.de: The change remains, but I am beginning to cope with it.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_AdjustmentStress.stages.1.de: Everything feels unfamiliar. I do not know how to continue.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_DissociationAftermath.label: reality still feels distant
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_DissociationAftermath.stages: Everything still seems distant and unreal, as if behind a thin veil.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_TraumaFlashback.label: traumatic flashback
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_TraumaFlashback.stages.0.des: The trauma is replaying before me as though it were happening now.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_DissociativeAmnesia.label: gap in memory
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_DissociativeAmnesia.stages.0: There is an inexplicable blank space in my memory.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_HypomaniaPhase.label: hypomanic cycle
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_HypomaniaPhase.stages.0.desc: My energy and thoughts are stable for now.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_HypomaniaPhase.stages.1.desc: My thoughts feel light and fast, as though I can accomplish anything.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_CyclothymiaPhase.label: mood cycle
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_CyclothymiaPhase.stages.0.de: My mood is sinking, and I cannot find enthusiasm for anything.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_CyclothymiaPhase.stages.1.de: My mood is rising, and I feel unusually positive.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BipolarIIPhase.label: bipolar cycle
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BipolarIIPhase.stages.0.desc: A heavy depression is suppressing all of my energy.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BipolarIIPhase.stages.1.desc: Energy and confidence keep surging through me. I can barely stop.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BipolarIPhase.label: bipolar cycle
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BipolarIPhase.stages.0.label: depressive phase
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BipolarIPhase.stages.0.descr: Everything has lost meaning, and even moving feels difficult.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BipolarIPhase.stages.1.label: manic phase
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BipolarIPhase.stages.1.descr: I have endless energy. Nothing can stop me.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SchizoaffectivePhase.label: schizoaffective cycle
Depression and exhaustion occupy my thoughts.
My thoughts are accelerating as my energy and confidence expand.
Reality feels unreliable, and everything seems to conceal a hidden meaning.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BorderlinePhase.label: important relationship
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BorderlinePhase.stages.0.des: This is the only person who truly understands and values me.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_BorderlinePhase.stages.1.des: The person who matters most has abandoned me again.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SchizotypalPhase.label: strange beliefs
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SchizotypalPhase.stages.0.de: Solitude keeps me away from signals I cannot explain.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SchizotypalPhase.stages.1.de: Ordinary events seem to conceal omens intended only for me.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_PersistentLowEnergy.label: persistent low mood
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_PersistentLowEnergy.stages.0: My mood remains low, but I can still maintain daily life.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_PersistentLowEnergy.stages.1: Persistent exhaustion and depression make action difficult.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SomaticConcern.label: physical discomfort
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SomaticConcern.stages.0.desc: The physical discomfort has at least stopped worsening for now.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SomaticConcern.stages.1.labe: something is wrong with my body
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_SomaticConcern.stages.1.desc: These sensations prove that something is seriously wrong with my body.
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_OCPDUrge.label: the work is not perfect yet
LanguageData.MMD_Thought_OCPDUrge.stages.0.descriptio: The details are still imperfect. I have to check again.
